value.answer: Ear pulling and crying at night is often an ear infection in toddlers, especially after a cold, but I can't see your child so I can't say for sure. Pain lasting over a day is worth a doctor visit.
value.triage: Call 811 today or see your doctor, especially if there's fluid, pus or blood from the ear, or fever over 39C. Go to the ER or call 911 now for stiff neck, unsteady walking, a crooked smile, or if they're limp, very drowsy or hard to wake.
